outcomes.title: Probabilistic multi-sensor field-state diagnosis method
outcomes.description: A calibrated probabilistic method (and its software implementation) that fuses radar, optical, soil-sensor, weather and field-observation data into posterior estimates of the latent field state, via Route A (direct probabilistic fusion) and/or Route B (homogeneous-patch proxy).
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open research software and methods; peer-reviewed publication; contribution to the standalone research demonstrator. Specific exploitation partners are spine-dependent and Unresolved.

outcomes.title: Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop decision engine
outcomes.description: An integrated decision engine that calibrates AquaCrop while retaining an honest parameter posterior, runs counterfactual irrigation simulations over weather ensembles, and recommends the option with the best expected economic return.
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open research software; publication; integration into the demonstrator. Downstream operational exploitation depends on the (unresolved) host and validation partners.

outcomes.title: Field-validation dataset and uncertainty-calibration evidence
outcomes.description: A validation dataset (ground truth, sensor comparison) and calibration evidence establishing whether the diagnosis and decision recommendations are credible and whether reported uncertainty is well calibrated, including a test of Route B's patch-covariation assumption.
outcomes.exploitation_route: Open validation data and protocol; publication. The validation sites, farms and ground-truth arrangements are spine-dependent and Unresolved (RQ4).

outcomes.title: Standalone research demonstrator (web MVP)
outcomes.description: An end-to-end demonstrator presenting irrigation recommendations with their uncertainty, integrating the diagnosis and decision engine as a research artefact.
outcomes.exploitation_route: Standalone research demonstrator with partners assisting (feedback, farmer access, testing) rather than owning or operating it. TRL target Unresolved (RQ10).

outcomes.exploitation_route: Open-access dissemination; open data/models under FAIR principles. Specific venues and target audiences are not asserted and are refined with the host.
